title: Repo foundations and AGENTS.md exist
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Repository foundations
  Scenario: Agent reads project conventions
    Given the Auritus repository is checked out
    When an agent opens AGENTS.md
    Then it sees Git Flow with develop as integration and main as release
    And Kanbus is mandatory
    And .kanbus.yml uses console_port 4257 and project_key auritus
```

## Implementation brief
1. Ensure LICENSE (MIT), README.md, .gitignore, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md, .kanbus.yml, Makefile exist at repo root.
2. GitHub remote AnthusAI/Auritus public.
3. Branches: develop (integration), main (release).
4. Acceptance: files present; `gh repo view AnthusAI/Auritus` succeeds.
right_now_summary: Repository foundation files and project conventions are defined, including Git Flow, Kanbus, and GitHub settings.
